name: What is the sewage damage restoration process?

mainEntity.name: What is the sewage damage restoration process?

acceptedAnswer.text: The sewage damage restoration process typically begins with a thorough assessment of the affected areas. Technicians then extract standing sewage and remove all contaminated porous materials. This is followed by a deep cleaning and disinfection phase, using professional-grade sanitizers to eliminate bacteria and odors. Finally, specialized drying equipment is used to remove moisture, and the area is reconstructed or repaired to its pre-damage condition. Monitoring and testing ensure the space is fully restored and safe.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves assessment, sewage extraction, removal of contaminated materials, deep cleaning, disinfection, drying, and final repairs.
